about: SEC-3 contract between av-approval (publisher) and av-events (subscriber).
av-approval publishes exactly these fields on the plugin event bus; av-events rebuilds the event from them.
A record with a missing or extra field, or a field not matching its rule, is dropped whole and counted
as plugin_dropped_<reason>. Two exceptions: a regex field with mismatch null (name, install_host, hermes_version)
is sent as null when its string does not match, and an int with above clamp (tools, hooks) is sent as the range's
maximum when larger. A non-string where a string belongs, or a negative int, still drops the record.
av-events also nulls a value its credential redaction (sanitize) would rewrite, or drops the record as bad_shape
where the field is not nullable; that rule is av-events' own and is tested there, not in these vectors.
Every regex must match the WHOLE string (Python re.fullmatch): a trailing newline does not match.
hermes_version's regex is agentvillage-data's hermesVersion pattern (src/schemas/index.ts) character for character.
Ints are ints (never bool or float); enums and regex fields are strings; null only where nullable is true.
Both sides' tests read this file: a rename on either side fails a test.

plugin.unknown.event_id: derived uuid v7 (ms 0) of HMAC-SHA256 under the tenant's av-events hash key over 'av-events|plugin.unknown|<name_hash>|<revision or empty>|<state>|<action>|<source>'

about: SEC-6 half 2 contract between av-approval (publisher, 0.5.0) and av-events (subscriber). Its own section, so the
SEC-3 keys above stay exactly as av-approval's SEC-3 parity test reads them. The same publisher rules as SEC-3:
exactly these fields, in this order; a missing, extra, ill-typed, out-of-set, out-of-shape or out-of-range field
drops the whole record, counted as model_dropped_<reason>. Two exceptions: model (a string longer than
max_length, checked first, or not matching its regex) and hermes_version (not data's shape) are sent as null.
model is never lower-cased. allowlist_version that is a string but not 12 lowercase hex drops the record.
ts is an int of epoch seconds in range; a bool, a float or a string drops it.
av-events also nulls a value its credential redaction (sanitize) would rewrite, or drops the record as bad_shape
where the field is not nullable; that rule is av-events' own and is tested there, not in these vectors.
Every regex must match the WHOLE string (Python re.fullmatch): a trailing newline does not match.
model's regex is the cp's MODEL_ID and agentvillage-data's AGENT_MODEL_ID_PATTERN; hermes_version's is the
SEC-3 one above (data's hermesVersion) character for character.
outcome: accept (emitted as emits), null (emitted, a sent string nulled, as emits), drop (nothing emitted,
counter incremented once). Both sides' tests read this section: a rename on either side fails a test.
